description: This source file implements platform-specific OS functions for IEEE 1905.1/1a stack on Linux, including interface management, socket creation, netlink event handling, and route querying.

methods.name: packet_socket_list_get
methods.description: Retrieve a packet socket from the list based on interface name and socket type.

methods.name: packet_socket_list_add
methods.description: Add a new packet socket to the list with specified interface name, index, file descriptor, and type.

methods.name: packet_socket_list_remove
methods.description: Remove a packet socket from the list and free resources.

methods.name: packet_socket_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a packet is received on a socket; forwards packet to registered packet callback.

methods.name: packet_socket_remove
methods.description: Remove socket for a given interface name and type.

methods.name: packet_socket_create
methods.description: Create a raw socket for a specific interface and type, bind, set multicast, and add to socket list.

methods.name: packet_sockets_create
methods.description: Create both 1905 and LLDP sockets for a given interface.

methods.name: packet_sockets_remove
methods.description: Remove both 1905 and LLDP sockets for a given interface.

methods.name: get_power_state
methods.description: Retrieve the power state (up/down) of a network interface.

methods.name: get_mac
methods.description: Retrieve MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: fill_interface_data
methods.description: Fill in interface info structure with data from system and configuration.

methods.name: create_primary_vlan_if_name
methods.description: Generate VLAN interface name based on pattern, interface name, and offsets.

methods.name: interface_add
methods.description: Add an interface to internal list and data model, optionally create VLAN name.

methods.name: interface_get
methods.description: Retrieve interface info from internal list by name.

methods.name: interface_get_phys
methods.description: Get physical interface info matching a VLAN interface name.

methods.name: interface_remove
methods.description: Remove an interface from internal list.

methods.name: interface_match
methods.description: Check if interface name matches configured regex.

methods.name: interface_match_vlan
methods.description: Check if interface name matches VLAN pattern and is associated with a physical interface.

methods.name: interface_updated_event
methods.description: Handle interface state change events, create or remove sockets accordingly.

methods.name: interface_removed_event
methods.description: Handle interface removal, cleanup sockets, and possibly recreate physical interface.

methods.name: interfaces_init
methods.description: Initialize interfaces: open socket, enumerate interfaces, add matching interfaces, create sockets.

methods.name: interfaces_fini
methods.description: Cleanup all interfaces and close socket.

methods.name: route_get_arp_entry
methods.description: Lookup MAC address for an IP in ARP cache.

methods.name: periodic_nl_route_query_cb
methods.description: Send netlink request to query routing table periodically.

methods.name: route_init
methods.description: Initialize route querying timer.

methods.name: route_fini
methods.description: Cleanup route query timer.

methods.name: parse_rtattr_flags
methods.description: Parse rtattr array with flags.

methods.name: parse_rtattr
methods.description: Parse nested rtattr array (Linux >= 3.8).

methods.name: parse_nested_rtattr
methods.description: Parse nested rtattr data (Linux >= 3.8).

methods.name: parse_if_info_state
methods.description: Extract interface name and port state from netlink message.

methods.name: netlink_event_newlink
methods.description: Handle netlink event for new link (interface up/down).

methods.name: netlink_event_dellink
methods.description: Handle netlink event for deleted link (interface down).

methods.name: netlink_event_newroute
methods.description: Handle netlink event for new route, update gateway MAC.

methods.name: netlink_socket_cb
methods.description: Callback for netlink socket; process messages and dispatch events.

methods.name: netlink_init
methods.description: Create and bind netlink socket, register callback.

methods.name: netlink_fini
methods.description: Cleanup netlink socket and callback.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_DUMP_INTERFACES
methods.description: Print current interface and socket info.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_GET_LIST_OF_1905_INTERFACES
methods.description: Get list of enabled 1905 interfaces.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_FREE_LIST_OF_1905_INTERFACES
methods.description: Free list of interface names.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_GET_1905_INTERFACE_INFO
methods.description: Get detailed info of a specific interface.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_IS_INTERFACE_UP
methods.description: Check if interface is up and active.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_GET_IFINDEX
methods.description: Get interface index.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_PACKET_SENT
methods.description: Increment packet sent counter for interface and type.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_GET_RAW_SEND_FD
methods.description: Get raw socket file descriptor.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_LOG_LEVEL_TRACE
methods.description: Check if log level is trace.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_GET_GATEWAY_MAC
methods.description: Get stored gateway MAC address.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_INIT
methods.description: Initialize platform OS functions, setup netlink, interfaces, routes.

methods.name: PLATFORM_OS_FINI
methods.description: Cleanup platform OS functions.
